Name: The Farmer That Stared at Rocks
Author: itslittany
Description:
Do you find pickaxes too heavy? 
Ever think your mind was destined for much greater things then just thinking? 
Do you enjoy staring at [s]goats[/s] rocks?
If you answered yes to the above then this mod maybe for you!
Simply stare at a rock to unleash its treasures but be warned, the harder the rock the longer you have to concentrate. 
If you are both lazy and patient this mod is for you

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Usage[/size]
Once you have installed the mod, walk up to any rock/ore in the mine, once you stop moving you will see a message pop up and after a few seconds (varies depending on the rock/ore) it will break open!
